correct_text_routing.path: vLLM W8A8 INT8 text + deterministic tools
correct_text_routing.notes: Correct TEXT_ONLY routing stays on resident text path; no VLM load.

extra_cost_components: stop/sleep text vLLM to free KV (production util=0.90 cannot co-reside)
unnecessary_vision_routing_false_positiv.swap_unload_overhead_note: Stage J established swap/unload is required at text util=0.90 but did not measure end-to-end swap/unload wall time; do not invent an exact latency.
unnecessary_vision_routing_false_positiv.impact: Each FP vision route pays full swap + VLM invocation cost for a query that should have stayed on the cheap text/tool path.

missed_vision_routing_false_negatives.impact: FN vision routes keep image-understanding questions on text/tools, which cannot see the figure → likely answer correctness failure (wrong or unsupported visual claims).

on_vision_request: stop/sleep text vLLM to release KV reservation
serve vision request(s) at low concurrency
swap_policy.optional_demo_coresidency: Both can co-reside if text util≈0.40 (combined idle ~18487.0 MB, free ~5595.0 MB) with much smaller text KV.
swap_policy.rationale: Production text util=0.90 reserves ~22GB; VLM needs ~7–8GB torch — OOM beside production text.
